items.mainDefect: Translating the error_short variable prevents error-message literals from being extracted for translation.

secondary.defect: The spelling "Github" should be normalized to "GitHub".

items.mainDefect: MAX_ALLOWED_REQUESTS is set to 150 instead of 100.

secondary.defect: performSearch() is unnecessarily wrapped in requestAnimationFrame.
The sanitization function is named sanitizeInput instead of sanitize.
Analytics timing uses Date.now() instead of performance.now().
The /api/data request uses GET instead of POST.
Form handling may incorrectly map body.name to fields other than input[name="name"].
